title: questlogframe
summary: MSUI's quest log (Program.Quest.cs, log mode of the shared quest window) exists with the UI-QuestLog book art, title, 'n / 20' count, six selectable title rows, a detail area with quest title + objectives text, and working Abandon (CMSG_QUESTLOG_REMOVE_QUEST) and Close buttons. Registry's 13/13 opcodes are about the wire, not the window - the list and detail panes are far thinner than the reference/Benilla.

openItems.text: List shows only the first 6 quests with no scroll offset, wheel, or scrollbar - quests 7..20 are unreachable in the log UI
No zone/category headers on the list (Benilla defers too, but MSUI also lacks the flat-list scroll that makes >6 reachable)
No quest level or difficulty coloring on title rows (reference QuestDifficultyColor law)
Detail pane has no per-objective progress lines (kill/item counters with done-coloring) - a single cached progress string with a placeholder fallback stands in
No rewards section (items/money/spell) in the log detail pane
No quest-watch tracking (SHIFT-click watch toggle, on-screen tracker)
Abandon sends immediately with no ABANDON_QUEST confirmation popup
Share Quest button is permanently disabled (no quest push) - matches Benilla's own v1 stub, noted for completeness
